column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the firmament of his strength” is rendered “His mighty firmament.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּתֵקַע שׁוֹפָר (“the ram’s horn”) is rendered “the trumpet,” and “lyre” “lute.”
Close to the Hebrew; “cymbals of sound… cymbals of shouting” is rendered “loud cymbals… clashing cymbals.”
